title: Fertilizer purchase path credits the requested tokenAmountIn rather than the actually-received Barn-Raise token amount (argument-based accounting, raw transferFrom)
description: FertilizerFacet.mintFertilizer -> LibFertilizer.addFertilizer pulls the Barn-Raise token with a raw, return-value-unchecked IERC20(barnRaiseToken).transferFrom(user, this, tokenAmountIn) and then uses the SAME tokenAmountIn argument for (a) the well addLiquidity tokenAmountsIn, (b) the Fertilizer/recapitalization accounting (recapitalized += usdAmount derived from tokenAmountIn), and (c) the minted Fertilizer id/amount. There is no balanceOf-before/after measurement. If the Barn-Raise token were ever a fee-on-transfer or rebasing token, the contract would record/recapitalize more value than it actually received, drifting recapitalization accounting and over-issuing Fertilizer relative to backing. With the current Barn-Raise token (wstETH via BEAN_WSTETH_WELL — non-rebasing, standard, returns bool) there is no drift and the raw transferFrom cannot silently fail, so the live impact is nil. This contrasts with the Silo deposit path, which correctly uses the receiveToken balance delta.
impact: Latent accounting-drift / over-issuance risk that only materializes if a fee-on-transfer or rebasing token is selected as the Barn-Raise token. Bounded to Low because the Barn-Raise token is governance-controlled and is currently wstETH (standard, non-FOT). Raw transferFrom return value is also unchecked, but wstETH reverts on failure so it is benign here.

ite.intent: Record Fertilizer/recapitalization equal to the value actually delivered to the protocol
ite.technique: Argument-based accounting (tokenAmountIn) instead of measured balanceOf delta, combined with raw transferFrom
ite.evasion: Only triggers if governance whitelists a non-standard Barn-Raise token; standard wstETH gives no drift

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.sys.fert.recapitalized and minted Fertilizer amount (would exceed value actually received for an FOT/rebasing barn-raise token)
ice_chain.impact: Over-recapitalization / over-issued Fertilizer vs. backing; addLiquidity may also revert (DoS) on under-delivered amount
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibFertilizer.remainingRecapitalization / Sun fertilizer payout read s.sys.fert.recapitalized and Fertilizer balances
ice_chain.exploit_path: mintFertilizer(tokenAmountIn) -> addFertilizer raw transferFrom + argument-based usdAmount -> recapitalized/Fertilizer overstated only when barnRaiseToken is FOT/rebasing
